title: 第5章 初习武道

content_zh:
“练拳，练三个小时。”老头道：“练拳重要的不是动作的正确，而是如何与腹中的玄气进行交流，让你的拳法和玄气融会贯通，学会如何掌握你腹中的玄气。不但要会将玄气从筋脉中汇聚到气海，还要学会将气海中的玄气引发到筋脉各处，这样才能起到战斗的作用。”
“怎么样交流？”阳顶天问道。
老头道：“去感觉它！”
说完后，老头闭上双眼。
阳顶天开始练习正阳拳的第一招，一开始睁着眼睛连，一板一眼不敢练错一点，结果小腹气海中的玄气完全没有反应，练习了几十遍，玄气依旧没有反应。于是，阳顶天索性闭上眼睛联系，也不去管招式准确不准确了，逼着眼睛去感受那股玄气，结果让他喜出望外，那只小老鼠竟然蠢蠢欲动。但也仅仅只是蠢蠢欲动，仿佛吸引力不够，不能够将他引到筋脉各处去。
阳顶天依旧闭目练拳，拼命用心去感受那只小老鼠，拼命地想去亲近它召唤它。谁知道，你越想亲近它，它越是矜持，一开始还蠢蠢欲动，后来索性懒洋洋地不理会了。
于是，阳顶天再次睁开双眼，也不去理会这只玄气小老鼠，一板一眼完全按照正确的方式进行练习，又练了几十遍。然后，再次闭着眼睛练习，去感受那只玄气小老鼠。
谁知刚刚闭目去练习拳法，用心去感受那只小老鼠，那只小老鼠反而迫不及待地猛地跳起来，几乎就要散到全身筋脉去。
阳顶天大喜，这玄气小老鼠就仿佛真的活的一般。跟你若即若离，你拼命想亲近它反而不理你，你不理会它了，它反而贴上来。
阳顶天赶紧再次闭目练拳，要再次感受这股玄气。这个世界的武道太奇妙了，阳顶天毫无抵抗就沉迷了进去。
“今天到此为止，不要再练了。”老头忽然道。
“可是，那只小老鼠猛地一跳，我马上就要成功了。”阳顶天道。
”它今天不会再跳回你的筋脉去了，刚才它猛地一跳，已经是今天最大的成果了。”老头道：“不要练了，再练反而会倒退了。”
“唉！人比人，气死人。”老头再次叹息道，然后缓缓闭上眼睛。
阳顶天不信邪，继续偷偷的练习。没有想到真的如同老头所说，非但没有进一步进展，反而大大退步了，那老鼠兴奋度越来越小，最后索性懒洋洋在那里一动不动了。
第二天，阳顶天继续练气一个小时，感觉到小老鼠好像大了一些，活跃度也高了一些。
但是后来三个小时的正阳拳，尽管已经把小老鼠勾引得拼命跳跃了，但还是没能将它召唤出气海。仿佛，那个气海对小老鼠有无比的吸引力一般，它怎么都舍不得出去。
第三天，第四天，第五天！
终于，阳顶天将小老鼠引出小腹的气海了，就如同真的老鼠一样，在他的身体到处乱跑，完全无法控制，每跑到一处地方，那个地方就发热，感觉好像鼓起来一般，阳顶天再次低呼出声。
老头睁开眼睛，看到阳顶天到处乱跑的模样，叹息地摇了摇头道：“人比人，气死人。”

别人需要三个月才能将玄气从气海中引到筋脉去，阳顶天只需要五天。
“坐下闭目调息，玄气就会自动回到气海了。”老头道：“正阳拳的第一招，就是引气作用。将筋脉中的玄气凝聚到气海中，积少成多，使得玄气变得强大。然后，再将这股玄气从气海中引出到筋脉中去。”
“所以，第一招你算是练完了。”老头道：“接下来第二招，就是教你学习如何引导控制这股玄气，什么时候收，什么时候发，让这股玄气去到哪里。”
“第三招，是教你如何分离玄气，总不能每次打人都将所有的玄气打出去，有些时候只是为了教训人，而不是打死人，所以只能打出一部分留一部分。”
“第四招，是让你学习在引导玄气出了气海，对敌人进行进攻，却又中途停止，将玄气停留在某处筋脉，引而待发。”
“第五招，是如何用玄气进行攻击的同时，又快速凝聚全身筋脉的全新玄气来到气海，准备下一次的进攻。”
“第五招最重要。”阳顶天道。
“没错，第五招最重要，也最难。”老头道：“人体筋脉好像小溪江河，玄气仿佛上面的流水。小腹气海就仿佛汪洋大海，小溪入小河，小河入大河，大河入大江，大江入大海。玄气来源于天地万物，人体的每一个毛孔，每一寸地方都在吸收玄气。当气海中的玄气打出去后，筋脉的玄气能够快速凝聚入气海，与此同时身体的每一处又开始从天地间吸引玄气。整个过程，源源不绝，循环不止。但是速度有快慢，你打完一拳将玄气全部打完了，却要足足两分钟后才能再次凝聚玄气，那早就死了十次八次了。”

content_en:
"Practice boxing for three hours." The old man said: "The important thing about boxing training is not the correct movements, but how to communicate with the mysterious energy in your belly, so that your boxing skills and mysterious energy can be integrated, and learn how to master the mysterious energy in your belly. Not only must you gather the mysterious energy from the muscles and veins into the sea of ​​qi, but you must also learn to induce the mysterious energy in the sea of ​​qi to all the muscles and veins, so that it can play a fighting role."
"How to communicate?" Yang Dingtian asked.
The old man said: "Go and feel it!"
After finishing speaking, the old man closed his eyes.
Yang Dingtian began to practice the first move of Zhengyang Fist. At first, he kept his eyes open and did not dare to make any mistakes. As a result, the Xuan Qi in the Qi Sea in his lower abdomen did not respond at all. After practicing dozens of times, the Xuan Qi still did not respond. So, Yang Dingtian simply closed his eyes to communicate, regardless of whether the moves were accurate or not, and forced his eyes to feel the mysterious energy. The result made him overjoyed, and the little mouse was ready to move. But it was just about to move, as if the attraction wasn't enough to lead him to all the places in his veins.
Yang Dingtian still practiced boxing with his eyes closed, trying his best to feel the little mouse with his heart, trying desperately to get close to it and summon it. Who knows, the more you want to get close to it, the more reserved it becomes. At first it was ready to move, but later it simply ignored you lazily.
So, Yang Dingtian opened his eyes again, ignored the mysterious little mouse, and practiced exactly in the correct way, and practiced it dozens of times. Then, practice again with your eyes closed to feel the mysterious little mouse.
Who would have thought that just when I closed my eyes to practice boxing and felt the little mouse with my heart, the little mouse jumped up impatiently, almost spreading to all the veins in its body.
Yang Dingtian was overjoyed, this mysterious little mouse seemed to be really alive. It seems to be far away from you. You desperately want to get close to it but it ignores you. You ignore it and it sticks to you instead.
Yang Dingtian quickly closed his eyes and practiced boxing again to feel this mysterious energy again. The martial arts in this world were so wonderful that Yang Dingtian was addicted to it without any resistance.
"That's it for today, no more practice." The old man suddenly said.
"But that little mouse jumped suddenly, and I was about to succeed." Yang Dingtian said.
"It won't jump back to your muscles and veins today. The sudden jump it made just now is already the biggest result today." The old man said, "Stop practicing. If you practice any more, you will go backwards."
"Alas! It's so annoying when people compare themselves to each other." The old man sighed again, and then slowly closed his eyes.
Yang Dingtian did not believe in evil and continued to practice secretly. Unexpectedly, as the old man said, instead of making further progress, it actually regressed greatly. The mouse's excitement became less and less, and finally it simply lay there motionless.
The next day, Yang Dingtian continued to practice Qi for an hour and felt that the little mouse seemed a little bigger and more active.
But after three hours of Zhengyang Fist, although it had seduced the little mouse into jumping like crazy, it still failed to summon it out of the air sea. It seemed that the sea of ​​​​qi was extremely attractive to the little mouse, and it was reluctant to get out no matter what.
The third day, the fourth day, the fifth day!
Finally, Yang Dingtian led the little mouse out of the sea of ​​​​qi in his lower abdomen. Just like a real mouse, it was running around in his body, completely uncontrollable. Every time he ran to a place, that place became hot and felt like it was bulging. Yang Dingtian let out a low breath again.
The old man opened his eyes and saw Yang Dingtian running around. He sighed and shook his head and said, "Comparing people with each other is so annoying."
It takes others three months to guide the profound energy from the sea of qi to the muscles and veins, but Yang Dingtian only needs five days.
"Sit down and close your eyes and adjust your breath, and the profound energy will automatically return to the sea of ​​​​qi." The old man said: "The first move of Zhengyang Fist is to draw the qi. Condensing the profound qi in the muscles and veins into the sea of ​​​​qi, accumulating less into more, making the profound qi become stronger. Then, againLead this mysterious energy from the sea of ​​energy to the muscles and veins. "
"So, you have finished practicing the first move. The old man said: "The next step is to teach you how to guide and control this mysterious energy, when to close it, when to send it out, and where to let this mysterious energy go." "
"The third trick is to teach you how to separate the profound energy. You can't knock out all the profound energy every time you hit someone. Sometimes it's just to teach people a lesson, not to kill them, so you can only shoot out part of it and leave the other part. "
"The fourth move is for you to learn to guide the profound energy out of the sea of ​​qi, attack the enemy, but stop midway, and let the mysterious energy stay in a certain vein, ready to attack. "
"The fifth move is how to use profound energy to attack and at the same time quickly gather the new profound energy from all the muscles and veins in the body to come to the sea of ​​qi to prepare for the next attack. "
“The fifth move is the most important. "Yang Dingtian said.
"Yes, the fifth move is the most important and the most difficult. The old man said: "The muscles and veins of the human body are like streams and rivers, and the mysterious energy is like the flowing water above." The sea of ​​Qi in the lower abdomen is like a vast ocean, with small streams flowing into small rivers, small rivers flowing into large rivers, large rivers flowing into large rivers, and large rivers flowing into the sea. Xuan Qi comes from all things in the world, and every pore and every inch of the human body absorbs Xuan Qi. When the profound energy in the sea of ​​​​qi is beaten out, the profound energy in the muscles and veins can quickly condense into the sea of ​​​​qi, and at the same time, every part of the body begins to attract profound energy from the world. The whole process is endless and endless. But the speed varies. After you have punched out all the Xuan Qi, it will take a full two minutes before you can condense the Xuan Qi again. In that case, you will have died ten or eight times. "
